correctness.rationale: Complete constructive proof: alpha(c union S)=max(alpha(S),1+# distal) and non-link faces have exactly k-1 distal vertices. Closed stars are balls Delta^{k-2}*(S0)^{*(k-1)} whose intersection with link is the entire boundary, and distinct interiors are disjoint; cofiber quotient yields wedge of binom(m,k-1) spheres integrally. For m<k-1 the complex is a cone. Ten exhaustive finite link/star checks and five exact mod-two homology calculations independently corroborate.
